code='def transform(grid):
    # The marked color defines a stencil; paint matching placements on zero cells.
    color=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,1))
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(i for i,j in pts); c0=min(j for i,j in pts)
    shape={(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in pts}
    h=max(i for i,j in shape)+1; w=max(j for i,j in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(len(grid)-h+1):
        for j in range(len(grid[0])-w+1):
            if all(grid[i+di][j+dj]==0 for di,dj in shape):
                for di,dj in shape: out[i+di][j+dj]=color
    return out
'
